d1.q: I have a sore throat. I should drink some hot tea with ____.
d1.explain: 蜂蜜(honey)水润喉，是缓解喉咙痛的常见建议。

d1.q: Yesterday Tom ____ a cold and stayed at home.
d1.explain: yesterday 表明是一般过去时，have 的过去式是 had。

d1.q: You'd better ____ too much junk food.
d1.explain: had better 的否定形式是 had better not do sth。

d1.q: The boy was too tired, so he fell ____ in class.
d1.explain: fall asleep 是固定搭配，意为“睡着”。

d1.q: If your nose ____, you may have a cold.
d1.explain: if 引导的条件句用一般现在时，主语 nose 是第三人称单数。

d1.q: The nurse asked me to ____ my temperature.
d1.explain: take one's temperature 意为“量体温”。

d1.q: It's important ____ enough water every day.
d1.explain: It's + adj. + to do sth. 结构，it 是形式主语。

d1.q: The old man ____ off his bike and hurt his arm.
d1.explain: fall off 意为“从……摔下”，过去式是 fell。felt 是 feel 的过去式。

d1.q: I feel ____, so I want to lie down for a while.
d1.explain: dizzy 意为“头晕的”，与躺下休息相符。

d1.q: Aron Ralston is a mountain ____ who lost his right arm.
d1.explain: mountain climber 意为“登山者”，此处需要名词。

d1.q: We should ____ risks, but we must be careful.
d1.explain: take risks 是固定搭配，意为“冒险”。

d1.q: Doctors say that eating too much sugar is bad ____ our teeth.
d1.explain: be bad for 意为“对……有害”。

d1.q: She left the room without ____ a word.
d1.explain: without 是介词，后接动词的 -ing 形式。

d1.q: There is something wrong ____ my eyes.
d1.explain: There is something wrong with sth. 意为“某物出毛病了”。

d1.q: Thanks to the passengers, the bus driver ____ in time.
d1.explain: 司机是被救，用一般过去时的被动语态 was saved。

d1.q: Mr. Green is used to ____ up early every morning.
d1.explain: be used to doing sth. 意为“习惯于做某事”，to 是介词。

d1.q: Which of the following are illnesses or symptoms?
d1.explain: fever 发烧、cough 咳嗽、stomachache 胃痛都是病症；notebook 是笔记本。

d1.q: Which sentences correctly give advice?
options: Why not lie down and rest?
d1.explain: should 后接动词原形，不能加 to，故第三项错误。

d1.q: Which words are related to first aid?
d1.explain: 绷带、药、医院都与急救有关；football 无关。

d1.q: Which phrases mean to be in trouble or danger?
d1.explain: have a good time 意为“玩得开心”，不表示困境。

d1.q: Which of the following can correctly follow 'without'?
d1.explain: without 后接 -ing 形式，不能接动词不定式。

d1.q: 'What's the matter?' and 'What's wrong?' have similar meanings.
d1.explain: 两者都用来询问“怎么了”。

d1.q: We say 'have a fever' to mean the body temperature is high.
d1.explain: have a fever 意为“发烧”。

d1.q: The correct form is 'should to go'.
d1.explain: should 是情态动词，后接动词原形 go，不能加 to。

d1.q: 'Used to do' means something happened in the past but not now.
d1.explain: used to do 表示过去的习惯或状态，现在已不再如此。

d1.q: 'Fall asleep' means to wake up.
d1.explain: fall asleep 意为“入睡”，wake up 才是“醒来”。

d1.q: 英语中“发烧”的常用表达是 have a ____.
d1.explain: have a fever 意为“发烧”。

d1.q: Doctors and ____ (nurse, 用复数) work in hospitals.
d1.explain: and 连接并列名词，此处用复数 nurses。

d1.q: He is good at ____ (control) himself in danger.
d1.explain: be good at 后接动名词，control 双写 l 加 -ing。

d1.q: She cut her finger, so she needed a ____（绷带）.
d1.explain: bandage 意为“绷带”。

d2.q: We decided ____ the old people's home this Saturday.
d2.explain: decide to do sth. 意为“决定做某事”。

d2.q: The students volunteer ____ their time to help others.
d2.explain: volunteer to do sth. 意为“自愿做某事”。

d2.q: Could you please help me ____ out these notices?
d2.explain: help sb. (to) do sth.，此处用动词原形 hand。

d2.q: Mario loves animals, so he works at an animal ____.
d2.explain: animal hospital 意为“动物医院”，适合喜爱动物的人做志愿者。

d2.q: Jane is ____ about reading, so she volunteers in a library.
d2.explain: be excited about 意为“对……感到兴奋”。

d2.q: He put ____ a notice to ask for volunteers.
d2.explain: put up a notice 意为“张贴通知”。

d2.q: Please don't ____ your old books. Give them to poor children.
d2.explain: throw away 意为“扔掉”。

d2.q: She used to ____ afraid of speaking in public.
d2.explain: used to 后接动词原形 be。

d2.q: Helping others makes me ____ happy.
d2.explain: make sb. do sth. 中用不带 to 的不定式。

d2.q: We should try ____ our best to help people in need.
d2.explain: try to do one's best 意为“尽力去做”。

d2.q: Thanks to the volunteers, the park ____ much cleaner now.
d2.explain: now 表明用一般现在时，主语 the park 是第三人称单数。

d2.q: My sister often helps me ____ my homework.
d2.explain: help sb. with sth. 意为“在某方面帮助某人”。

d2.q: The charity ____ money to build schools in poor areas.
d2.explain: raise money 意为“筹款”，raise 是及物动词。

d2.q: Zhang Ming is a ____ boy; he always helps others.
d2.explain: kind 意为“友善的”，与乐于助人相符。

d2.q: We cheered ____ the players at the sports meeting.
d2.explain: cheer sb. on 意为“为某人加油”。

d2.q: He gave ____ his free time to help sick children.
d2.explain: give up one's free time 意为“牺牲空闲时间”。

d2.q: Which are places for volunteer work?
d2.explain: 购物中心不是典型的志愿服务场所。

d2.q: Which phrasal verbs mean 'to distribute'?
d2.explain: give out 与 hand out 都表示“分发”。

d2.q: Which sentences use the infinitive correctly?
d2.explain: want 后接不定式，应为 want to help。

d2.q: Which words describe a helpful person?
d2.explain: mean 意为“吝啬的、刻薄的”，是贬义词。

d2.q: Which of the following can mean 'to establish'?
d2.explain: give away 意为“赠送”，不表示“建立”。

d2.q: 'Volunteer' can be used both as a noun and as a verb.
d2.explain: volunteer 既可作名词“志愿者”，也可作动词“自愿做”。

d2.q: 'Cheer up' and 'cheer on' have exactly the same meaning.
d2.explain: cheer up 是“使高兴起来”，cheer on 是“为……加油”。

d2.q: 'Put off' means to delay something.
d2.explain: put off 意为“推迟”。

d2.q: 'Try out' means to test something to see if it is good.
d2.explain: try out 意为“试用、试验”。

d2.q: The sentence 'I decided going home' is correct English.
d2.explain: decide 后接不定式，应为 decided to go home。

d2.q: The students ____ (decide) to clean up the beach last weekend.
d2.explain: last weekend 表明用一般过去时。

d2.q: 英语中“无家可归的人”表达为 the ____ people.
d2.explain: homeless 意为“无家可归的”。

d2.q: He is used to ____ (get) up early to help his parents.
d2.explain: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。

d2.q: 短语填空：I want to ____ ____ my old clothes to poor children.（赠送）
d2.explain: give away 意为“赠送、捐赠”。

d3.q: — Could you please pass me the salt? — ____
d3.explain: 对礼貌请求的肯定回答，并递上物品。

d3.q: Teenagers should learn to be ____ and do things by themselves.
d3.explain: independent 意为“独立的”。

d3.q: Please ____ the floor before dinner.
d3.explain: sweep the floor 意为“扫地”。

d3.q: My mother asked me to ____ the clothes after they were dry.
d3.explain: fold the clothes 意为“叠衣服”。

d3.q: Could you please ____ the dog for a walk?
d3.explain: take the dog for a walk 意为“遛狗”。

d3.q: I don't like doing chores, but I have to help ____ the housework.
d3.explain: help with sth. 意为“帮忙做某事”。

d3.q: As soon as the movie ____, we will go home.
d3.explain: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来。

d3.q: Neither my brother nor I ____ good at cooking.
d3.explain: neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，靠近 I，用 am。

d3.q: — Could I go to the movies tonight? — ____ You have to finish your homework first.
d3.explain: 后句说明要先写作业，因此是委婉拒绝。

d3.q: Don't ____ your clothes on the floor. Put them away.
d3.explain: throw ... on the floor 意为“把……扔在地上”。

d3.q: He is old enough to ____ care of himself.
d3.explain: take care of 意为“照顾”。

d3.q: The room is very ____. Let's clean it up.
d3.explain: messy 意为“凌乱的”，与需要打扫相符。

d3.q: My father usually ____ out the rubbish in the evening.
d3.explain: take out the rubbish 意为“倒垃圾”。

d3.q: Doing chores helps children understand the ____ of hard work.
d3.explain: the value of hard work 意为“辛勤劳动的价值”。

d3.q: Would you mind ____ the window? It's cold.
d3.explain: Would you mind doing sth.? 后接动名词。

d3.q: I'll do the dishes ____ I finish my dinner.
d3.explain: 吃完饭之后洗碗，用 after 合乎逻辑。

d3.q: Which are polite ways to ask for permission?
options: Do you mind if I sit here?
d3.explain: 祈使句 Give me your phone. 是命令，不礼貌。

d3.q: Which are chores usually done in the kitchen?
d3.explain: 浇花通常在阳台或花园完成。

d3.q: Which answers agree to a request?
d3.explain: 最后一项是拒绝。

d3.q: Which sentences are imperative sentences?
d3.explain: 祈使句以动词原形或 Don't 开头，第三项是陈述句。

d3.q: Which words are about housework?
d3.explain: homework 是家庭作业，不属于家务。

d3.q: 'Do the dishes' means to wash the dishes after a meal.
d3.explain: do the dishes 就是“洗碗”。

d3.q: 'Take out the rubbish' means to bring the rubbish outside.
d3.explain: take out the rubbish 意为“倒垃圾”。

d3.q: After 'Would you mind', we use a verb in the -ing form.
d3.explain: mind 后接动名词作宾语。

d3.q: In 'Neither of them ____ here', the verb should be plural.
d3.explain: neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语通常用单数。

d3.q: In 'as soon as' clauses, we use the future tense to talk about the future.
d3.explain: 时间状语从句中用一般现在时表示将来。

d3.q: 英语中“洗衣服”的常用表达是 do the ____.
d3.explain: do the laundry 意为“洗衣服”。

d3.q: Could you please ____ (feed) the cat for me?
d3.explain: Could you please 后接动词原形。

d3.q: As soon as he ____ (get) home, he will call you.
d3.explain: 从句用一般现在时表将来，主语 he 用第三人称单数。

d3.q: 短语填空：Please ____ ____ your toys before you go to bed.（收拾好）
d3.explain: put away 意为“把……收起来”。

d4.q: My parents want me ____ a doctor in the future.
d4.explain: want sb. to do sth. 意为“想要某人做某事”。

d4.q: Why not ____ a walk to relax yourself?
d4.explain: Why not + 动词原形，用来提建议。

d4.q: There is too much ____ on students nowadays.
d4.explain: pressure 是不可数名词，意为“压力”。

d4.q: He is worried ____ the coming exam.
d4.explain: be worried about 意为“为……担心”。

d4.q: My teacher always ____ me to work harder.
d4.explain: encourage sb. to do sth. 意为“鼓励某人做某事”。

d4.q: Don't ____ your problems in your heart. Talk to someone.
d4.explain: keep sth. in one's heart 意为“把某事憋在心里”。

d4.q: The two brothers often ____ about small things.
d4.explain: argue about sth. 意为“为某事争吵”。

d4.q: I'm afraid ____ making mistakes in class.
d4.explain: be afraid of doing sth. 意为“害怕做某事”。

d4.q: He turned off the light ____ his sister could sleep well.
d4.explain: so that 引导目的状语从句。

d4.q: Parents should ____ their children more freedom.
d4.explain: give sb. sth. 意为“给某人某物”。

d4.q: It's a good idea ____ your feelings with your best friend.
d4.explain: It's + 名词 + to do sth. 结构。

d4.q: She didn't stop working ____ midnight.
d4.explain: not ... until ... 意为“直到……才”。

d4.q: Communication is the best way to ____ problems between parents and children.
d4.explain: solve problems 意为“解决问题”。

d4.q: My mother often compares me ____ other children.
d4.explain: compare A with B 意为“把 A 和 B 作比较”。

d4.q: You'd better ____ your parents about your worries.
d4.explain: tell sb. about sth. 意为“告诉某人关于某事”。

d4.q: Everyone needs someone to talk ____ when they feel unhappy.
d4.explain: talk to sb. 意为“与某人交谈”，此处不定式后需保留介词 to。

d4.q: Which sentences are used to give suggestions?
options: Why don't you have a rest?
How about going for a walk?
d4.explain: 最后一句只是陈述事实，不是建议。

d4.q: Which verbs can be followed by 'sb. to do sth.'?
d4.explain: enjoy 后接动名词，不能用 enjoy sb. to do。

d4.q: Which are common problems for teenagers?
d4.explain: 睡眠充足是好事，不是烦恼。

d4.q: Which words mean 'nervous or worried'?
d4.explain: relaxed 意为“放松的”，意思相反。

d4.q: Which phrases are correct?
d4.explain: 正确形式是 allow sb. to do sth.。

d4.q: 'How about doing sth.?' is a way to give advice.
d4.explain: How about doing...? 是常见的提建议句型。

d4.q: After 'allow sb.', we use a verb in the -ing form.
d4.explain: allow sb. to do sth.，应接动词不定式。

d4.q: 'So that' introduces a clause of purpose.
d4.explain: so that 引导目的状语从句。

d4.q: 'Hang out' means to spend time with friends.
d4.explain: hang out 意为“闲逛、与朋友消磨时光”。

d4.q: Parents and children should never talk about their problems.
d4.explain: 沟通是解决亲子矛盾的最好方式。

d4.q: My parents don't allow me ____ (watch) TV on school nights.
d4.explain: allow sb. to do sth. 结构。

d4.q: 短语填空：You should learn to ____ ____ well with your classmates.（相处）
d4.explain: get on well with sb. 意为“与某人相处融洽”。

d4.q: 英语中“压力”一词是 ____.
d4.explain: pressure 意为“压力”，是不可数名词。

d4.q: Don't be ____ (害怕的) of telling your parents the truth.
d4.explain: be afraid of doing sth. 意为“害怕做某事”。

d5.q: While my mother was cooking, I ____ my homework.
d5.explain: while 引导的从句和主句都表示过去正在进行的动作。

d5.q: The rainstorm ____ when we were having lunch.
d5.explain: when 引导的短暂动作用一般过去时。

d5.q: They ____ not sleeping when the alarm went off.
d5.explain: 主语 they 是复数，过去进行时的 be 动词用 were。

d5.q: ____ was he doing at eight o'clock last night?
d5.explain: 询问“在做什么”用 What。

d5.q: The heavy rain ____ the streets and many cars couldn't move.
d5.explain: flood 意为“淹没”，符合暴雨后的情景。

d5.q: I was so ____ that I couldn't fall asleep.
d5.explain: 修饰人的感受用 -ed 形容词 frightened。

d5.q: He was walking home ____ it started to snow.
d5.explain: when 可引导突然发生的短暂动作。

d5.q: The wind was blowing so ____ that I couldn't stand still.
d5.explain: blow hard 意为“猛烈地刮”；hardly 意为“几乎不”。

d5.q: Everyone ____ silent when the teacher came in.
d5.explain: fall silent 意为“安静下来”，过去式是 fell。

d5.q: The girl was too ____ to speak after the accident.
d5.explain: too + 形容词 + to do，scared 意为“害怕的”。

d5.q: At that moment, people ____ TV to get the news.
d5.explain: at that moment 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。

d5.q: The alarm ____ off while I was taking a shower.
d5.explain: go off 意为“响起”，过去式是 went。

d5.q: It was raining ____, so we stayed at home.
d5.explain: 修饰动词 rain 要用副词 heavily。

d5.q: The city was in a ____ after the rainstorm.
d5.explain: in a mess 意为“一片狼藉”，mess 是名词。

d5.q: She was reading a book ____ her brother was playing computer games.
d5.explain: while 表示两个同时进行的长动作。

d5.q: The news reported that the storm ____ many houses.
d5.explain: 宾语从句叙述过去发生的事，用一般过去时。

d5.q: Which words are about a rainstorm?
d5.explain: sunshine 意为“阳光”，与暴风雨无关。

d5.q: Which sentences are in the past continuous tense?
d5.explain: 第三句是一般现在时。

d5.q: Which can correctly follow 'while' in a sentence about the past?
d5.explain: 最后一项动词形式错误，应为 the phone rang。

d5.q: Which are sensible things to do before a storm?
d5.explain: 暴风雨前外出游泳非常危险。

d5.q: Which time expressions can be used with the past continuous?
d5.explain: every day 常与一般现在时连用。

d5.q: 'While' is usually used with a continuous action.
d5.explain: while 后常接延续性动作，多用进行时。

d5.q: The past continuous form of 'they' is 'they was doing'.
d5.explain: they 是复数，应为 they were doing。

d5.q: 'The phone rang while I was sleeping' is a correct sentence.
d5.explain: 短暂动作用过去时，while 从句用过去进行时，搭配正确。

d5.q: The past continuous can describe the background of a story.
d5.explain: 过去进行时常用来交代故事发生的背景。

d5.q: 'Go off' can mean an alarm making a sound.
d5.explain: go off 可表示闹钟或警报“响起”。

d5.q: What ____ (be) you doing when I called you?
d5.explain: 过去进行时的疑问句，主语 you 用 were。

d5.q: It ____ (rain) hard when we left school.
d5.explain: 离校时雨正在下，用过去进行时。

d5.q: While the boy ____ (play) outside, his mother was cooking.
d5.explain: while 引导的从句用过去进行时。

d5.q: 英语中“暴风雨”一词是 ____（以 r 开头的合成词）。
d5.explain: rainstorm 由 rain 和 storm 合成，意为“暴风雨”。

d6.q: Long long ago, a young man ____ in a small village.
d6.explain: 讲故事用一般过去时。

d6.q: ____ you work hard, you will not succeed.
d6.explain: unless 意为“除非、如果不”，符合句意。

d6.q: The Monkey King can ____ himself into different animals.
d6.explain: turn ... into ... 意为“把……变成……”。

d6.q: As soon as the story ____, the children began to clap.
d6.explain: 主句是过去时，从句也用一般过去时。

d6.q: The emperor was so ____ that he believed the two men.
d6.explain: 被骗说明皇帝很愚蠢，用 stupid。

d6.q: He put on his new clothes and ____ them to everyone.
d6.explain: show sth. to sb. 意为“给某人看某物”。

d6.q: Nothing is impossible ____ you keep trying.
d6.explain: as long as 意为“只要”。

d6.q: The story ____ us that we should never give up.
d6.explain: tell sb. that... 意为“告诉某人……”。

d6.q: The gods were so moved that they ____ the two mountains away.
d6.explain: take away 意为“拿走、搬走”。

d6.q: Yu Gong was very ____; he never stopped working.
d6.explain: hard-working 意为“勤劳的”。

d6.q: Hou Yi shot down nine suns ____ save the people.
d6.explain: 动词不定式 to save 表示目的。

d6.q: Once upon a time, there ____ a king and a queen.
d6.explain: there be 句型遵循就近原则，a king 后跟 queen 构成并列复数，此处强调两人，用 were。

d6.q: The weather was so hot that the crops ____ die.
d6.explain: 主句是过去时，从句也用过去式 began。

d6.q: Yu Gong's neighbour ____ him for being silly.
d6.explain: laugh at sb. 意为“嘲笑某人”。

d6.q: We should learn ____ the old man's spirit.
d6.explain: learn from 意为“向……学习”。

d6.q: Journey to the West is a ____ novel written by Wu Cheng'en.
d6.explain: 《西游记》是吴承恩所著的著名小说。

d6.q: Which are characters in Chinese traditional stories?
d6.explain: Cinderella 灰姑娘来自西方童话。

d6.q: Which words can describe Yu Gong?
d6.explain: 愚公坚定、勇敢、勤劳，绝不懒惰。

d6.q: Which sentences use the simple past tense correctly?
d6.explain: 第三句应为 She went home.。

d6.q: Which of the following are conjunctions that can join two clauses?
d6.explain: very 是副词，不能连接分句。

d6.q: Which phrases mean 'to continue doing something'?
d6.explain: give up doing 意为“放弃做某事”，意思相反。

d6.q: The Monkey King is a character from Journey to the West.
d6.explain: 孙悟空是《西游记》中的人物。

d6.q: 'Unless you hurry, you will be late' means 'If you don't hurry, you will be late'.
d6.explain: unless 相当于 if...not。

d6.q: In the past tense, the verb 'shoot' becomes 'shooted'.
d6.explain: shoot 是不规则动词，过去式是 shot。

d6.q: 'Laugh at someone' means to make fun of someone.
d6.explain: laugh at 意为“嘲笑”。

d6.q: In the story, Hou Yi shot down all ten suns.
d6.explain: 后羿射下九个太阳，留下一个。

d6.q: The old man ____ (tell) the story to his grandson last night.
d6.explain: last night 表明用一般过去时，tell 的过去式是 told。

d6.q: Unless you ____ (work) hard, you will fail the exam.
d6.explain: unless 引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时。

d6.q: 英语中“愚公移山”里“移动”这一动词是 ____.
d6.explain: move the mountains 意为“移山”。

d6.q: The two mountains were very ____ (高的), so it was hard to move them.
d6.explain: high 意为“高的”，用来形容山。
